snippet.title: MMORPG NPC Simulator - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam:  (https://store.steampowered.com/app/3964340/MMORPG_NPC_Simulator/?utm_source=Youtube&utm_content=Trailer)

Play as an NPC in an MMORPG world and grow your shop. Give quests to players, drop items, and sell legendary gear. Form teams of players and send them on raids. Ban cheaters and take control of the game. Manage the servers, set the rules, and shape the balance as you see fit.
